customManagers.description: Dependabot cannot track a GitHub-release tarball pinned in a Dockerfile ARG; the other five ecosystems here (composer, npm, github-actions, docker, gomod) already have Dependabot covering them in .github/dependabot.yml, so this manager is the only one enabled.
mago is a release binary installed by the Lint workflow, not a composer dependency, so the composer manager does not see the version in extra.
biome is installed from a release asset; the version lives only in the $schema URL, which has to keep matching the binary.
